scope: All 138 previously maintained Release guide, Shared guidance, Splunk Forwarders and Splunk SOAR URLs plus two newly confirmed official component sources; current discovery streams; affected Cloud 10.4 and Observability component claims; bounded high-consequence Enterprise, Cloud, migration, Forwarder, security, premium-product, SCMA and SOAR claims. verifiedClaims.productVersionEnvironment: Splunk Cloud Platform 10.4.2604.15; Splunk-managed Cloud maintenance
verifiedClaims.qualification: Published October 12, 2026. The feed lists a Universal Forwarder preinstall/package-stop correction plus indexer, SAML, authentication-observability and Google Cloud KMS fixes. Preliminary security counts do not establish CVE scope, and publication does not establish selected-stack rollout, entitlement, region or customer-managed installation.
verifiedClaims.followUp: Require the selected stack's exact four-segment build and affected-workflow retest before relying on a fix.

verifiedClaims.productVersionEnvironment: Splunk OpenTelemetry Collector for Kubernetes chart 0.162.1; customer-managed component
verifiedClaims.qualification: Published October 13, 2026. The chart still adopts Collector 0.162.0, removes the Light Prometheus Receiver and feature gate, and updates the OpAMP Bridge. This is not a new standalone Collector or rolling SaaS release.
verifiedClaims.followUp: Remove the retired gate; validate endpoint discovery, telemetry, resource use, bridge permission and Fleet Management identity continuity.

verifiedClaims.followUp: Retain the 2.13.0 configuration and image checks and validate resolved dependencies, startup and representative telemetry.
